dataset.title: Multibeam bathymetry and acoustic-backscatter data collected in 2015 near Cross Sound, southeast Alaska, during field activity 2015-629-FA

scientific_goal: Second formal unseen bathymetry-to-backscatter validation in an open-ocean corpus with a different sensor, geography and native scale from Lake Sammamish.

method_transfer.origin: Lake Sammamish formal PASS method; no Cross Sound numeric outcomes were inspected before this freeze.
method_transfer.reason: Preserve the frozen 4/8/16/32-cell morphology ladder and 8-cell sampling stride at 10-m native resolution.

bathymetry_discovery.followup_rule: at least two morphology families in upper tail OR generic score in upper 0.5 percent
bathymetry_discovery.common_center_validity: candidate sample centers must have complete valid bathymetry support through maximum frozen radius 320 m

backscatter_replay.patch_geometry: candidate disk radius r plus annulus 1.25r < distance <= 2r
backscatter_replay.zero_mad_rule: exclude metric when same-radius control MAD is exactly zero
backscatter_replay.aggregate_score: 0.5*max(active positive robust z)+0.5*mean(active positive robust z)

primary_test.stratified_permutation: preserve frozen candidate count by radius
promotion_requires_all: no radius stratum with fewer than 2 active nonzero-MAD metrics
candidate mean aggregate score > control mean aggregate score
primary_test.secondary: one-sided Mann-Whitney candidate aggregate scores > controls
